content: Posaconazole increases the levels of digoxin by reducing its metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole significantly increases the levels or effects of dihydroergotamine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Posaconazole also increases the levels or effects of intranasal dihydroergotamine via CYP3A4 inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of diltiazem by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Both disopyramide and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. This combination is serious; consider using an alternative therapy. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of disopyramide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of docetaxel by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. Both dofetilide and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Both dolasetron and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Both donepezil and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of donepezil by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of doravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration of doravirine with CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase plasma concentrations and toxicities of doravirine. Monitor closely. Both doxepin and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Dronabinol is a CYP3A4 substrate. Monitor closely when coadministered with posaconazole. Both dronedarone and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. This combination is serious; use an alternative therapy. Dronedarone increases the levels or effects of posaconazole via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. The combination of dronedarone with other QT-prolonging medications is contraindicated. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of dronedarone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Both droperidol and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of dutasteride by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of duvelisib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Coadministration with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor increases duvelisib AUC, potentially increasing the risk of duvelisib toxicities. Reduce the duvelisib dose to 15 mg BID when coadministered with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of edoxaban via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) inhibition. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Dose adjustment may be required with strong P-gp inhibitors. For DVT/PE treatment, decrease the edoxaban dose to 30 mg PO once daily. For NVAF, no dose reduction is recommended. Both efavirenz and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. This combination is contraindicated. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of efavirenz by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of elacestrant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of posaconazole via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) inhibition. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of elagolix by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Coadministration of elagolix 200 mg BID with strong CYP3A inhibitors for more than one month is not recommended. Limit elagolix dose to 150 mg qDay and CYP3A inhibitor duration to six months if coadministered. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of elbasvir/grazoprevir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of eletriptan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of eliglustat by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors are contraindicated with eliglustat in poor or intermediate metabolizers. Reduce eliglustat dose from 84 mg BID to 84 mg once daily in extensive metabolizers. Eliglustat is contraindicated if strong or moderate CYP2D6 inhibitors are given concomitantly with strong or moderate CYP3A inhibitors. Eliglustat increases the levels of posaconazole via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) inhibition. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Both eliglustat and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. This combination is contraindicated. Posaconazole increases the levels of elvitegravir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Elvitegravir is a CYP3A4 substrate. Coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase elvitegravir levels. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of encorafenib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. If concomitant use of a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor is unavoidable, reduce the encorafenib dose to one-third of the original dose (e.g., reduce from 450 mg/day to 150 mg/day). Both encorafenib and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Posaconazole increases the toxicity of enfortumab vedotin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Enfortumab vedotin is an antibody-drug conjugate that releases monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE) via proteolytic cleavage. MMAE is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 in vitro. Coadministration with dual P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase MMAE exposure, potentially increasing the risk of enfortumab vedotin toxicities. Monitor closely for signs of toxicities. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of entrectinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid coadministration of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors with entrectinib, a CYP3A4 substrate. Both entrectinib and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of enzalutamide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Both epinephrine and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Both racemic epinephrine and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of eplerenone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of erdafitinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. If unable to avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors, monitor closely for adverse reactions and consider decreasing the erdafitinib dose accordingly. If the strong CYP3A4 inhibitor is discontinued, consider increasing the erdafitinib dose in the absence of any drug-related toxicities. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of ergoloid mesylates by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of ergonovine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of ergotamine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Both eribulin and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of erlotinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Erythromycin base increases the levels or effects of posaconazole via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) inhibition. Both erythromycin base and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Erythromycin ethylsuccinate increases the levels or effects of posaconazole via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) inhibition. Both erythromycin ethylsuccinate and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Erythromycin lactobionate increases the levels or effects of posaconazole via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) inhibition. Both erythromycin lactobionate and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Erythromycin stearate increases the levels or effects of posaconazole via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) inhibition. Both erythromycin stearate and posaconazole prolong the QTc interval. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of escitalopram by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Escitalopram increases the toxicity of posaconazole by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of esomeprazole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Esomeprazole decreases the levels or effects of posaconazole by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of estradiol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of vaginal estradiol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration with CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase plasma concentrations of estrogens and their toxicities. Monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of conjugated synthetic estrogens by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of esterified estrogens by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of estropipate by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of eszopiclone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of ethinyl estradiol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of ethosuximide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Ethotoin decreases the levels of posaconazole by increasing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of etonogestrel by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of etoposide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of eucalyptus by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is minor, and its clinical significance is unknown. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of everolimus by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Ezogabine and posaconazole both increase the toxicity of each other by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Slight and transient QT prolongation has been observed with ezogabine, particularly when the dose is titrated to 1200 mg/day. The QT interval should be monitored when ezogabine is prescribed with agents known to prolong the QT interval. Famotidine decreases the levels or effects of posaconazole by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Use caution and monitor closely. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of fedratinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. If unable to avoid fedratinib coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors, decrease the fedratinib dose to 200 mg/day. If the CYP3A4 inhibitor is discontinued, increase the fedratinib dose to 300 mg/day for two weeks, and then to 400 mg/day thereafter as tolerated. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of felbamate by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is serious; avoid or use an alternative drug. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of felodipine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely.
